title: CA 19-9 Test for Pancreatic Cancer: Meaning, False Positives and When to Order
description: What CA 19-9 measures, why a high or normal result cannot diagnose pancreatic cancer, Lewis antigen limitations and monitoring uses.

faq.question: What is the normal CA 19-9 range?
faq.answer: Use the reference interval printed by the performing laboratory for its assay; there is no single result that confirms or excludes pancreatic cancer.

faq.question: Can jaundice raise CA 19-9?
faq.answer: Yes. Bile-duct obstruction and related inflammation can cause elevations independent of cancer.

faq.question: Is CA 19-9 a cancer screening test?
faq.answer: No. It is not recommended as a screening test in average-risk people without symptoms.
